title: Rethinking and Improving Natural Language Generation with Layer-Wise Multi-View Decoding
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving natural language generation models and evaluates their performance on various tasks such as machine translation, summarization, image captioning, and medical report generation using standard metrics.
